So many waterfalls to see in Iceland! Seljalandsfoss was a sight to see! Stay on the left side going up and down for an easier walk but higher chances of getting wet. Stay on the right going up and down for a more challenging walk, but less chances of getting wet! Or mix which way you go up and down! #Seljalandsfoss #traveltiktok #travel #iceland #godscreation
